label: first copy step (input = orig token 0, right after <DEL>) in longer sequences
explanation: Low end of candidate unit 115 is mostly active on the first step after <DEL> (recall_idx == 1, input is the first original token fed back, output is orig(1)). That step has firing rate 0.41 (8.2x lift) and holds 75% of activation mass, and it covers 87% of the top activation quartile. Firing rate and magnitude grow with sequence length (rate ~0 at L=3-4, highest at L=9), and also depend on which token is fed back: u, v, j, 3, c give high rates and many other letters (d, h, l, i, x, z, b) are often silent. Weaker secondary activity: recall_idx == 2 in long sequences (~11% of mass) and the last original steps (orig_idx 7-8, ~12% of mass, often lower magnitude). Essentially never active in the first five steps, at mid/late copy positions (recall_idx >= 3), or on the delimiter step itself. A first-token allowlist raises precision to ~0.89 but loses recall, so token dependence is graded rather than clean.
